vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-71556
vulnerability.description: go-git: worktree operations may follow symlinks

statements.impact_statement: go-git backs gomplate's git://, git+https:// and git+ssh:// datasources. This image invokes gomplate with env: datasources only, so no repository is ever cloned and no worktree operation runs.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-71557
vulnerability.description: go-git: malicious reference names may modify files outside the reference storage

statements.impact_statement: go-git backs gomplate's git://, git+https:// and git+ssh:// datasources. This image invokes gomplate with env: datasources only, so no remote reference is ever fetched or stored.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-56854
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: source-address critical option not enforced for non-public-key auth callbacks

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects golang.org/x/crypto/ssh and concerns an SSH server authorising a connection. gomplate imports golang.org/x/crypto only for bcrypt; x/crypto/ssh is reached solely through go-git's SSH transport, which this image never exercises, and gomplate runs no SSH server.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-56855
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: denial of service on a deadlocked established channel

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects golang.org/x/crypto/ssh. gomplate imports golang.org/x/crypto only for bcrypt; x/crypto/ssh is reached solely through go-git's SSH transport, which this image never exercises.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-78662
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: denial of service on a deadlocked undecided channel

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects golang.org/x/crypto/ssh. gomplate imports golang.org/x/crypto only for bcrypt; x/crypto/ssh is reached solely through go-git's SSH transport, which this image never exercises.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which gomplate does not import. Its only use of golang.org/x/crypto is bcrypt, for the crypto.Bcrypt template function.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-84304
vulnerability.description: gRPC-Go: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation

statements.impact_statement: gRPC enters the binary transitively through the Google Cloud client libraries behind gomplate's gs:// datasource; gomplate's own source imports neither gRPC nor OpenTelemetry. This image invokes gomplate with env: datasources only, so no gRPC client or server is ever started and no HTTP/2 frame is parsed.
